fields.description: Which line of its section this column belongs to. A bank whose file opens with two header records puts one on row 1 and the other on row 2. Detail columns on row 2 write a second line per employee.

fields.description: Field: a column name from the Bank Remittance report, e.g. account_number. Composed: names joined by +, e.g. bank_code+branch_code. Constant: literal text, which may use {company} {currency} {period} {debit_account} {debit_bank_code} {debit_branch_code} {from_date} {to_date} {today} {count} {total}. Blank writes an empty cell, for a file that keeps a column it does not use.
fields.label: Value
